crossRefs.note: Jesus therefore said to them, “Most certainly, I tell you, it wasn’t Moses who gave you the bread out of heaven, but my…
They said therefore to him, “Lord, always give us this bread.”
The Jews therefore murmured concerning him, because he said, “I am the bread which came down out of heaven.”
Most certainly, I tell you, he who believes in me has eternal life.

translations.web: This is the bread which came down out of heaven—not as our fathers ate the manna, and died. He who eats this bread will live forever.”
translations.bsb: This is the bread that came down from heaven. Unlike your fathers, who ate the manna and died, the one who eats this bread will live forever.”
translations.kjv: This is that bread which came down from heaven: not as your fathers did eat manna, and are dead: he that eateth of this bread shall live for ever.
translations.asv: This is the bread which came down out of heaven: not as the fathers ate, and died; he that eateth this bread shall live for ever.
